readerCopy.summary: The person asking for the full record faces the institution determined to limit what can be seen.
readerCopy.body: The person asking for the full record faces the institution determined to limit what can be seen. One side cites public interest, inconsistency, and the right to know; the other cites confidentiality, risk, and the authority to withhold. Mercury keeps the questions specific, while Pluto holds the files, access, and consequences attached to releasing them. The opposition forces the questions to face the office with the power to bury the answer. A disclosure may follow, but the struggle shows how much truth depends on who controls the door to the evidence.
